query: Write a PRD for this idea.
expected_behavior: Produces all seven sections in order, with a goals table where each goal has a measure
Gives every screen Purpose, Layout, States, Controls, and APIs called
States the choices it made for missing facts (for example the payment timing edge cases) in the Overview instead of leaving placeholders
Writes requirements literally, with units on numbers

query: Review this PRD and tell me what's missing.
expected_behavior: Runs prd_lint.py and reports the failures it finds (TODO/TBD placeholders, missing States and APIs called, empty default and set-in cells, unmeasured goals, missing sections, no sources)
Lists fixes by section, each concrete enough to apply
Does not invent product facts; asks or marks decisions where the author must choose

query: Generate the PRD with a model instead of by hand, as a draft-review-refine chain on Opus 5.5.
expected_behavior: Uses the prompting-opus-5-5 kit.py to build three separate requests (draft, review, refine)
Lints the final PRD with prd_lint.py
